title: Activity-ledger line - Campus AI OS, one shape for registered and ad-hoc runs
description: ONE line shape for every activity-ledger line (Campus AI OS 5.3.0 item 4, agent-activity-logging standard, kernel half). Registered skill runs, playbook stages, scheduled jobs and ad-hoc turns all write this shape; an ad-hoc turn writes `skill: "ad-hoc"` and logs ONLY when it produced an output, a write or a decision (pure conversation does not log). WRITE side (`tools/validate_ledger.py --write`): the `required` keys must be present and every key typed as below. READ side (default): lines written before this schema (no `seat`, `timestamp` instead of `ts`, extra keys) are legacy, never failures; only a key that IS present with the wrong type fails. Extra keys are always allowed. Canon for where a line goes: templates/ledger-paths.md. Validator subset: tools/validate_results.py (type, required, enum, pattern, properties, items, minItems) plus `minimum`, applied by tools/validate_ledger.py.

ts.$comment: ISO 8601 date-time, UTC preferred (a bare date is read-accepted). Legacy lines may carry `timestamp` instead; read side accepts them.

seat.$comment: The seat resolve-seat.py returned. Never a literal copied from an example.

via.$comment: The `via` the seat resolver returned. New lines use these words only (write side); older words such as binding-file-read read as legacy, never as failures.

skill.$comment: The registered skill or playbook stage that ran, or "ad-hoc" for work with no matching skill.

skill_version.$comment: OPTIONAL (5.3.0, WikiSkill B): the `version` in the running skill's or playbook's frontmatter, read from the file and never typed from memory. Absent on ad-hoc lines and on lines written before 5.3.0.

logged_for.$comment: OPTIONAL, recommended on ad-hoc lines: why this turn logged. The logging rule is: an ad-hoc turn logs only for an output, a write or a decision.

dept.$comment: Canon spelling is `dept` (NICHE-009); never `team` for this field.

outcome.$comment: completed | errored | abandoned | partial, or a short owner-readable phrase (legacy).

output.$comment: Relative path to the artifact, or "".

provider.$comment: RESERVED for 5.3.1 (routing adapter), optional now: which provider served the call - e.g. host, local, openrouter. Absent = the host model.

model.$comment: RESERVED for 5.3.1, optional now: the model id actually served.

cost.$comment: RESERVED for 5.3.1, optional now: USD for this line's calls. Absent means not measured, never zero by default.
